title: WorkspaceExecutionPlan
description: A versioned manifest describing one mission that spans several repositories. It is a separate record above the single-repository Mission: each repository keeps its own parent orchestration run, target_repository, worktrees, tests and pull requests. Repository identity is explicit (owner/repository) and execution inputs are immutable: a pinned commit SHA, never a branch name.

check.description: A local command run with shell=False in a temporary detached worktree of the repository at the commit under validation. Only the exit status is recorded; output goes to a log in orchestrator state.

base_branch.description: Base branch for this repository's draft PRs.

objective.description: Optional repository-scoped, single-line instruction for this task. Existing manifests fall back to title. It is immutable for a dispatched execution id.

max_duration_seconds.description: Optional wall-clock limit for this task's child execution, in seconds; overrides the manifest default. Omitted: the manifest default, else no limit.

max_lead_calls.description: Optional limit on the lead's model calls for this task's child execution; overrides the manifest default. At the limit the run is stopped IN_PROGRESS (stopped_reason LEAD_CALL_LIMIT) and resumes only with a raised limit. Omitted: the manifest default, else the repository's .pi/autonomy.yaml limits.max_lead_calls, else no limit.

lead_calls_warn_at.description: Optional lead call at which the lead is told once to converge for this task; overrides the manifest default. Must be below the effective max_lead_calls. Omitted: the manifest default, else the repository policy, else 80% of max_lead_calls.

failure_retry_budget.description: Optional per-signature retry budget for this task's child execution; overrides the manifest default for how many times a worker step may be retried after a structured failure that repeats unchanged (same task, step, route epoch, failure code, worktree HEAD and declared-input digest) before the step is blocked with REPEATED_INEFFECTIVE_ACTION. 0 allows no retry. Prerequisite blockers never count. Omitted: the manifest default, else the repository's .pi/autonomy.yaml limits.failure_retry_budget, else 2.

readiness.description: Declared readiness of the task. Only ready_for_downstream and merged unblock dependents: implemented (a PR exists) and validated (tests pass) do not assert that the interface is stable.

mutation.description: local (default): the task's run creates worktrees and commits in its repository, so before launch the .pi/autonomy.yaml committed at the pinned commit must grant create_worktrees and commit and the scheduler must run with --allow-mutation; otherwise the task awaits authorization and nothing is launched. none: a read-only task that needs no mutation authorization. Ignored for qualification tasks.

kind.description: qualification tasks launch no child run: their checks run once every dependency is validated.

issue.description: Issue in this task's repository that its draft PR references: Refs #N, or Closes #N when the PR should close the issue on merge (see closes_issue).

closes_issue.description: true: the draft PR body says Closes #<issue>, so GitHub closes the issue when the PR merges. false: it says Refs #<issue>, which never closes it (use this when the task only partly addresses the issue). Omitted: follow the task repository's .pi/autonomy.yaml issue_reference (refs unless that file says closes).

requires.description: Each required contract must be provided, at the same version, by a direct dependency.

max_duration_seconds.description: Optional default wall-clock limit for each child execution, in seconds. A task's own max_duration_seconds overrides it. When a child reaches it, the launcher stops the child and ends the execution as cancelled with EXECUTION_TIME_LIMIT. Omitted: no limit. Unrelated to a check's timeout_seconds.

max_lead_calls.description: Optional default limit on the lead's model calls for each child execution. A task's own max_lead_calls overrides it. At the limit the run is stopped IN_PROGRESS (stopped_reason LEAD_CALL_LIMIT) and resumes only with a raised limit. Omitted: the repository's .pi/autonomy.yaml limits.max_lead_calls, else no limit.

lead_calls_warn_at.description: Optional default lead call at which the lead is told once to converge. A task's own lead_calls_warn_at overrides it. Must be below the effective max_lead_calls.

failure_retry_budget.description: Optional default per-signature retry budget for each child execution; a task's own failure_retry_budget overrides it for how many times a worker step may be retried after a structured failure that repeats unchanged (same task, step, route epoch, failure code, worktree HEAD and declared-input digest) before the step is blocked with REPEATED_INEFFECTIVE_ACTION. 0 allows no retry. Prerequisite blockers never count. Omitted: the repository's .pi/autonomy.yaml limits.failure_retry_budget, else 2.

budget.description: Optional spend limit across the workspace's child runs. The scheduler launches nothing once it is reached; running children are not stopped. max_cost_usd uses backend-reported cost, which only Claude workers report today, so it is a lower bound.

max_tokens.description: Input plus output tokens across all child runs.
